alt_text: Seven-slide carousel titled What a good sales handoff contains. Four list slides cover why the client bought, who decides, what success looks like in the pilot, and what the brand has already learnt; a slide gives the test of a good handoff; and the last slide asks readers to follow Galvor and comment handoff for the template.

slides.headline: What a good *sales handoff* contains
slides.sub: What I want in writing before my first call with a new brand.

slides.headline: Why they *bought*
items: The problem — in the client's words, from the sales call
The trigger — what made them act this month
The promise — exactly what sales said we'd deliver

slides.headline: Who *decides*
items: Day-to-day contact — who I speak to every week
Approver — who says yes to creative
Hidden reviewers — founder, legal, a regional head

slides.headline: What *success* looks like
items: Goal — the one result the pilot has to show

slides.headline: What they've *already learnt*
items: Past winners — ads or creators that worked
Past misses — what they never want again
Must-haves — claims, words and visuals that are fixed

slides.headline: Can I run the first call *without* sales?
slides.body:
If yes, the handoff worked.

If I need to ask sales a few questions first, those questions belong in the template next time.

slides.headline: Write the handoff *before* the kickoff.
slides.sub: Save this for your next new client.

title: What a good sales-to-servicing handoff contains
caption:
The first call after a deal closes tells a client a lot about us.
If I ask them something they already told sales, we've started badly.

That's why the handoff from sales to client servicing matters so much in a pilot. It's the moment a promise turns into a plan.

Since joining Galvor I've been building my own handoff checklist. Four groups of things I want in writing before my first call with a new brand: why they bought, who decides, what success looks like, and what they've already learnt.

Swipe for the list. Comment "handoff" and I'll send you the template.

Follow Galvor for more from the brief-to-live desk.
